description: Guarded recursion is legal and renders a finite tree: a depth attribute with `if=` on the nested use, and a field arm mounting a new instance (#2116 y04).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-component-self-mount-error ("Refuse unconditional (Recommended)" ... "Guarded recursion (under `if=` / `<match>`, a new instance each level) stays legal.")
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 2: "Guarded recursion is legal" — a nested use under `if=` / a state arm is a new instance each level.
